reason: It says it opens next year and my kid's birthday is in the next few months, so I can't book it for this one. Even if it were open, $325 plus a cake is a lot when a park pavilion or my own living room costs almost nothing.
objection: It's not open yet and I can't plan a real birthday around a place that might open next year. And I'm on a tight budget, so $325 is hard to justify when I can do a backyard or pavilion party for under $100.
would_change_my_mind: If it were already open with a firm date before my kid's birthday, and I could see it in person first. A price closer to $200 for the 12-kid party would help too.
